head: codex/4739-v0918-wp15-unity-mcp-alignment-prep
title: [v0.91.8][WP-15][unity][tooling] Align Unity-MCP live project and port proof for deployed observatory
body:
Closes #4739.

## Outcome

Adds a fail-closed Unity-MCP Observatory alignment lane that accepts read-only scene evidence only when the canonical project, persisted Custom mode, one loopback endpoint, editor liveness, MCP-reported `Application.dataPath`, permission-safe port status, and loaded scene all agree.

## Focused proof

- deterministic project, endpoint, Cloud-mode, ordering, failure, and redaction fixtures
- Observatory shell-contract guardrails
- validation-selector registration
- live local MCP proof against the intended Observatory editor and `FlagshipObservatoryStage`
- exact-head independent review with no actionable findings

## Boundary

This proves local Unity editor, MCP endpoint, project, and scene alignment. It does not claim runtime integration, visual quality, or investor readiness; those remain in the dedicated Unity demo issues.
